title: The Lantern Procession
text: A procession of floating lanterns drifts by in the dusk, paper and candle, silent, hundreds of them. Each one carries the soul of someone recently dead, the old folk say, on their way to wherever souls go. One of them flickers, and turns toward you.

options.label: The most troubled follows the lantern that turned to them.

outcomes.text: It is someone they knew, come to say goodbye, and they get to say it back.
It is very bright, and very sad, and it never stops looking for the others.
They pass, and the night is darker after, but the one that flickered toward you leaves a little warmth behind in every chest.

options.label: The devout one prays for the lantern that came close.

outcomes.text: It brightens, and goes on lighter, and its thanks sits in the devout one's hands as warmth.
